origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends; its tool names, its generation settings with a dynamic thinking budget, the functionCall and functionResponse parts with the ids of the gateway), model claude-sonnet-4.5: a tool call whose result is an error: the read of a file that does not exist (Chat has no is_error flag, the client writes the failure as text).
